meta.name: The Pharmacist 1080p
meta.description: After his son's tragic death, a Louisiana pharmacist goes to extremes to expose the rampant corruption behind the opioid addiction crisis.

videos.title: Justice for Danny
videos.overview: When his son is murdered in New Orleans, Dan launches a relentless and lonely search for the killer. As hope fades, he uncovers a miraculous lead.

videos.title: A Mission from God
videos.overview: The murder trial brings cold comfort. Trying to resume a normal life, Dan returns to work at the pharmacy and makes an alarming discovery.

videos.title: Dope Dealers with White Lab Coats
videos.overview: Dan's investigation into a corrupt doctor reveals some of big pharma's worst sins. Meanwhile, overdoses in town see a terrifying spike.

videos.title: Tunnel of Hope
videos.overview: Dan's smoking gun is a breakthrough for a major DEA case, but solving one problem creates another. A chapter closed, Danny's family moves forward.
